## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it belongs in Legion.

## User impact

Explain what users or maintainers will notice.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their outcomes.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] I removed credentials, tokens, private URLs, personal data, and local-only configuration.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated user-facing documentation when needed.
- [ ] I preserved upstream and third-party attribution notices.
- [ ] This is not an undisclosed security vulnerability; those are reported privately through `SECURITY.md`.
